text:
Alex: quick triage — CI on main turned red right after merge 74f2c9. Failing typecheck + format gate. https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/1234 :grimacing:
CI-bot: Job failed: pyright/typecheck (step 3). Log snippet below.
CI-bot: ```
app/runtime/kvcache.py:142: error: Incompatible types in assignment (expression has type "None", variable has type "str")
Found 1 error in 1 file (checked 124 source files)
```
Jia: ugh. Did the strict optional bump land in the last commit?
Alex: not sure, the PR touching kvcache was small. pinging @Riley and @Sam for quick help.
Riley: I can take a look in ~10. Can someone try a rerun first? sometimes it's flaky.
Sam: kicked off rerun job #1256
Alex: also seeing rustfmt fail in infra crate on the same build: `cargo fmt -- --check` returns non-zero
Sam: rerun passed for most jobs but pre-commit still failing on `end-of-line` and `black`.
Jia: local repro steps:
```
# python
poetry install
poetry run pre-commit run --all-files
poetry run pyright --project pyrightconfig.json
cargo fmt --all -- --check
```
Riley: if pre-commit fails, try `pre-commit run --hook-stage commit -a` or fix EOLs with `git add --renormalize .`
Maya: note: CI's pre-commit image updated black -> 23.1.0 yesterday, can cause formatting diffs.
Alex: ok I'm going to push a tiny formatting commit (normalize EOLs + black) then we can recheck type errors separately.
Riley: if the pyright error remains after formatting, I'll bisect the commit range on main between 74f2c9..HEAD
Sam: re-run triggered, I'll babysit. cc @Jia
Jia: thanks, will monitor logs and try local typecheck too. :thumbsup:
Alex: sweet. If anyone finds the strictness toggle, call it out here so we can pin until we fix tests.
CI-bot: Rerun results: pre-commit -> success, pyright/typecheck -> still failing on kvcache.py:142
Riley: got the local repro, pushing a quick fix to handle None -> explicit Optional[str] and adjust assignment.
Alex: looks good, thanks — please include a test. Once green I'll merge the fix and follow up on the config bump.
Sam: merge + CI green. closing triage. :tada:
